get.description:
REVIEWER+ can view any revision. EDITOR can view their own revisions (creator-only — ADMIN does not bypass this for other people’s drafts).

Returns a reviewer-shaped diff grouped by section: career fields, Read-only. The plan that backs this response is the same plan that submit, review, and publish use. Any divergence would let a reviewer approve something publish can't safely apply.

**stale** — `true` means the live career changed since this revision was created. The reviewer should request a rebase before approving.

**blockers** — hard stops. Non-empty means publish would fail. E.g. removing a step that learners have completed, missing required career fields, or an empty skills/steps list.

**advisories** — soft warnings shown as info banners. Do not block approval.

Field values are sent raw: decimals as strings (`"230000.00"`), arrays as arrays, foreign keys as both the raw UUID (`before` / `after`) and a human label (`beforeLabel` / `afterLabel`). The frontend formats currency and joins arrays.

post.description:
Minimum role: EDITOR.

Moves a DRAFT revision to IN_REVIEW, where it is frozen until a reviewer decides or the editor recalls it.

**Readiness:** the plan for the revision must have no blockers. Otherwise 400 `REVISION_NOT_READY` with the `blockers` list, and the revision stays DRAFT. A stale revision can still be submitted.

**Not a draft:** 409 `INVALID_REVISION_STATE`.

**Retired career:** 409 `CAREER_RETIRED`, unless the user is an ADMIN.

400.description: id is not a UUID, or REVISION_NOT_READY (the plan has blockers)

403.description: The user is below EDITOR

post.summary: Submit a draft revision for review

post.description:
Minimum role: EDITOR. Creator only — ADMIN does not bypass.

Rebase re-anchors a DRAFT revision onto the current live career version. It does NOT merge: the editor's snapshot is preserved as-is, and only `baseVersion` is moved forward. The editor then re-checks their draft against the new live state before submitting.

**Fresh draft (baseVersion === live version):** returns 200 with `rebased: false`. No write, no event.

**Stale draft:** writes the new `baseVersion`, returns 200 with `rebased: true`, emits `revision_rebased`.

**IN_REVIEW:** 409 `INVALID_REVISION_STATE`. Recall first (ticket 12), then rebase.

**Not the creator:** 403 `NOT_REVISION_CREATOR`.

200.description: Draft re-anchored (rebased: true) or already fresh (rebased: false).

403.description: The user is below EDITOR, or is not the revision creator

409.description: INVALID_REVISION_STATE (not a draft) or CAREER_RETIRED (career is retired)

post.summary: Rebase a stale draft onto the current live version

post.description:
Minimum role: REVIEWER.

Records a review and sets the revision to APPROVED or REJECTED. Approving publishes nothing; publishing is a separate step.

**Separation of duties:** a reviewer cannot review a revision they created, unless they are an ADMIN. Otherwise 403 `SELF_REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED`.

**Stale revisions:** approving is blocked with 409 `REVISION_STALE` when the live career changed since the revision was created. Rejecting is always allowed.

**Not in review:** 409 `INVALID_REVISION_STATE`.

400.description: id is not a UUID, or the body failed validation

403.description: The user is below REVIEWER, or reviewed their own revision (SELF_REVIEW_NOT_ALLOWED)

409.description: INVALID_REVISION_STATE (not in review) or REVISION_STALE (approval of a stale revision)

post.summary: Approve or reject a revision in review

post.description: Minimum role: EDITOR. Creator only, unless ADMIN. Moves an IN_REVIEW revision back to DRAFT so the editor can save changes again. Past reviews are kept.

403.description: The user is below EDITOR, or is not the revision creator and not an ADMIN (FORBIDDEN, code NOT_REVISION_CREATOR)

409.description: The revision is not in review (CONFLICT, code INVALID_REVISION_STATE)

post.summary: Recall a revision from review to draft

post.description:
Minimum role: PUBLISHER.

Applies an APPROVED revision to the live career in a single transaction. Nothing changes on any failure path.

**Pre-checks:**
- `409 REVISION_STALE` — the live career moved since the revision was based. Rebase and re-approve.
- `409 STEP_HAS_PROGRESS` — a removed step has learners. Details include stepId, stepTitle, learnersAffected.
- `409 CAREER_RETIRED` — the career is retired and the publisher is not ADMIN. Only an ADMIN may republish a retired career.
- `409 INVALID_REVISION_STATE` — the revision is not APPROVED.

**Separation of duties:** the publisher may be the same person as the reviewer. Approve records intent; publish is the mechanical apply. This may be tightened by the team later.

**On success:** applies the plan (career fields, outlook, resources, skills, pathway, steps with two-pass reorder, step skills, step resources), bumps `Career.version`, sets status PUBLISHED with publishedById/At and reviewedById/At, marks the revision PUBLISHED.

200.description: Revision published; live career now reflects the snapshot.

info.description:
API documentation for the Pathways backend.

Staff routes state their minimum role in the operation description. A minimum role also admits every higher role (ADMIN > PUBLISHER > REVIEWER > EDITOR > USER). A route that also lists exact roles requires both checks to pass. A missing token returns 401; an insufficient or unknown role returns 403.

badgesTotal.description: Badges in the catalogue, earned or not.
